bounds.domain: One branded runtime or isolated-test policy, one write, one process restart and one read under changing runner signals; a stable available or unavailable vault key.
bounds.limitations: Key identities are symbolic. Cryptographic security, arbitrary key rotation, filesystem crashes and root ownership are not established here; existing storage models cover publication and locks. Real Bun/Node subprocesses exercise encrypted bytes, explicit temporary roots, passphrase keys and unavailable-key refusal.

assumptions: Weak fairness of write, restart and read; storage and key resolution calls eventually return a value or error.
The runtime vault key is stable when available. No assumption grants an unavailable key or persists an isolated process key.
